= code-anchor-spacing(1)
:manmanual: Anchor spacing
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-02

== Name
code-anchor-spacing - enabled code targets preserve spacing

== Description

[source,text,subs=+macros]
----
C01 xanchor:code-joined[]y.
C02 x anchor:code-spaced[] y.
C03 xanchor:code-period[].
anchor:code-only[]
C04 End.
----

[source,text,subs="+quotes,+macros"]
----
C05 1anchor:code-formatted[]*Bold*.
----

[literal,subs=+macros]
....
  C06 xanchor:literal[]y.
....

[source,rust,linenums,subs=+macros]
----
// C07 xanchor:numbered[]y.
----

[source,text,subs=-macros]
----
C08 xanchor:disabled[]y.
----

<<<

See <<code-joined,Joined>>, <<code-spaced,Spaced>>,
<<code-period,Period>>, <<code-only,Only>>, <<code-formatted,Formatted>>,
<<literal,Literal>>, and <<numbered,Numbered>>.
